Take the information below and generate agent instructions .md file for it in the /doc directory. If a .md file name is provided, use that, otherwise generate an appropriate file name based on the generated content. Make sure the instructions are concise and not too long. Make sure to update the AGENTS.md file to reference this new docs file. If no information is provided below, prompt the user for more information about the layer of architecture or coding standards they want to document. The generated instructions should be clear and easy to follow, providing developers with the necessary guidelines to understand and adhere to the specified standards or architectural layer.
